text: Wind is different. It does not change the speed of sound relative to the air. It carries the air itself along. If a wind of speed w blows at an angle theta to the sound, the speed over the ground is v plus w cos theta. Downwind, the sound gets a push. Upwind, it is held back. That is why sound carries further downwind.
